Idaho's own method, ITD's Highway Safety Corridor Analysis (HSCA) ranks corridors by crash rate and its High Accident Location (HAL) list by a weighted score of frequency, rate and severity (Idaho HSIP 2024 annual report to FHWA, p. 10 of 41); neither is built here, isn't built: this report uses the HSM critical rate against the corridor's own sites (national method)
